about.title: About — Edwin Tony
about.description: Edwin Tony — CS student building real software experience through projects.
about.heading: A student building real experience
paragraphs: I'm a Computer Science student with a strong interest in software development and computer science fundamentals. For roughly the last two years I've been exploring programming through personal projects, tutorials, and academic work — not professional employment, but deliberate practice.

I enjoy building small applications end-to-end: designing the layout, writing the code, hitting bugs, reading error messages, and fixing things. I care about understanding and debugging code rather than just generating it, and I'm especially interested in how AI can assist — and where it can't replace — careful software engineering.
My goal is to grow into a well-rounded software developer through internships, more ambitious projects, and continuous learning. I'm currently working towards that, one project at a time.

projects.title: THE EXEMPTION
projects.problem: A college event project exploring public data, hidden trackers, data aggregation, location tracking, behavioural analysis, and digital privacy.
projects.contribution: Built an interactive data-broker competition concept using web technologies — HTML, CSS, and JavaScript on the front end, with Node.js/serverless functionality and Supabase for the backend.
projects.learned: How interactive data experiences are structured, how serverless and Supabase fit together, and how to design around a privacy-focused brief.
